Make every release smarter than the last.

We help teams and agents understand what users do, know what to improve, act on it, and measure whether it worked. From analytics to feedback to experimentation to code, Amplitude connects the full improvement loop so every release makes the next one smarter.

5 fast facts about Amplitude

01

700+ employees across the US, Europe, and Asia.

02

We’re building a culture where different perspectives make the work better.

03

5,200+ customers, including 30 of the Fortune 100, use Amplitude to make better digital bets.

04

We support the next generation of builders through programs like Amplitude Startup Scholarships.

05

For 14 years, we’ve helped teams understand users, improve products, and build what’s next.

How we got here

Innovation is in Amplitude's DNA. See where we started and how we got to our current era.

  • 2012: Amplitude’s co-founders are accepted into Y Combinator (YC W12) to help companies build better products with a deeper understanding of customer behavior.
  • 2014: Amplitude launches out of stealth as a real-time mobile analytics platform.
  • 2016: Amplitude raises $15MM in Series B funding led by Battery Ventures and is named Forbes Cloud 100 Rising Star.
  • 2018: Amplitude raises $80MM in Series D funding led by Sequoia Capital. We expand globally to London, Paris, Singapore, and New York City, and launch our Startup Scholarship.
